# Claude Code video editing: cut dead air and turn podcasts into Shorts

**Turn raw talking-head or podcast footage into a clean cut and vertical Shorts: word-level transcript, silence cuts, captions, FFmpeg.**

**Price:** free. Every step runs locally or only plans and writes; no API key.

<p><a href="../../edit-footage-with-code/README.md"><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_1c5ac9627ddb.webp" alt="A talking-head take edited in code: a woman at a podcast desk speaks with word-by-word captions that highlight the active word, then the shot punches in at the sentence break." width="480"></a></p>

**Short answer:** start with [`edit-footage-with-code`](../../edit-footage-with-code/README.md): read the take as text and audio, cut dead air, retakes and stumbles in the silences, write a reviewable edit list. The other 7 skills below add the steps around it. Ask your agent for the result in your own words; it asks the few choices that matter before anything is paid for and hands back the files.

```bash
# Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other agents
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill edit-footage-with-code --skill varg-video-editing --skill short-form-ffmpeg-cookbook --skill caption-styles --skill varg-video-edit-library --skill video-asset-sources --skill media-judge --skill video-project-github
```

Then ask your agent in plain words, for example: *"Cut the dead air, retakes and ums out of ./take.mp4 without clipping words. Show me the edit list before you cut."*

## FAQ

### Can Claude Code edit my videos?

Yes. edit-footage-with-code reads the take as text and audio, removes dead air, retakes and stumbles without clipping words, writes the cut as an edit list you review, then adds captions, B-roll and motion graphics in HyperFrames or Remotion. A plain cut needs FFmpeg only.

### How does it cut silences without clipping words?

It cuts only in the silence between words, at the quietest 10 ms slice, and finds real pauses from the audio, because word timestamps stretch across pauses: on the skill's test clip, gaps between words found 1 of 13 real pauses.

### Can it turn a podcast into Shorts?

Yes, as a reviewed edit: the agent reads the transcript to choose moments, you approve the plan, short-form-ffmpeg-cookbook crops each clip to 9:16 and burns captions. varg-video-editing names OpusClip when you want a hosted clipper instead.

### Will it overwrite my original footage?

No. The first rule is never overwrite the source; every step writes new files.

### Can I finish the edit in Premiere or Resolve?

Yes. The skill exports the cut as FCPXML for a person to finish in Resolve or Premiere.

### Does it cost anything?

The FFmpeg path is free and local. The varg ffmpeg tool (credits) is only for agents without a shell.
